summary: Frontend-only verification of BOM Explorer cache-first search + Refresh-from-SAP + live progress bar. All 4 review requirements pass end-to-end at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844.

test_results.cached_fast_path_100010102-A: PASS - rendered in 0.26s, 'Cached as of 8 Sept 2026, 12:56 pm' badge visible, Refresh-from-SAP button visible, no live-progress bar shown (correct for cache hit).
test_results.refresh_from_sap_click: PASS - old tree stayed visible under the progress bar, button correctly disabled with text 'Refreshing from SAP...' and spinner, progress bar showed level 1 of up to 6 with resolving-components counter (0->10->...), completed in ~21s, cached-as-of badge timestamp updated to 1:01:22 PM, tree still rendered after refresh.
test_results.never_seen_id_live_path: PASS - fake id 'ZZZFAKE-1788872507' correctly triggered live-progress bar within 2.5s (not blank/frozen), live job resolved in ~10s to 'BOM lookup failed - BOM ... not found in SAP' error alert (expected: id is not in SAP master data at all, so no item-lookup-card path was taken - this is correct 404 behavior, not a bug).
test_results.mobile_390x844: PASS - no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390) on either empty state or after loading the cached 100010102-A BOM. Badge/refresh-button row wraps cleanly.
test_results.console_errors: None. Only the standard React DevTools info log.

critical_code_review_comments: Cache-first flow works and the 'stale-while-refresh' UX (keep old tree visible during refresh) is correctly implemented - matches the spec exactly.
Progress bar text is clear and informative ('Pulling live from SAP - exploring level X of up to 6...' + 'N of ~300 components resolved') - solves the original 'blank spinner' complaint.
Regression items (AI Categorize toast, cost columns, tree, expand/collapse, refresh drawings, mobile layout) all render correctly - no visible regressions from the fetch-orchestration change.

context_for_next_testing_agent: BOM Explorer is the app root path '/'. Synthetic Entra session technique from /app/memory/test_credentials.md works reliably via page.context.add_cookies with url=BASE (not domain/path). Fake product IDs currently resolve via the live path to a 'not found in SAP' error alert (not the item-lookup-card) since there's no item master hit either - this is expected. To exercise the item-lookup-card branch you'd need a real un-cached product ID that has master data but no BOM.
rca of the issue: Not applicable - this was a frontend UX verification of an already-shipped performance fix, not a bug hunt. Fix is working as designed.
